title: Data and error
log: 2026-11-01T08:04:36Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: Neither bank point teaches the new point's full idea: the qualitative/quantitative card covers only part of it, and the measurement-accuracy card covers instrument absolute error, while primary/secondary data and random versus systematic error appear in neither.

draft.title: Data and error
card: Qualitative data is descriptive, such as words in an interview. Quantitative data is numerical, such as reaction times.
Primary data is collected first-hand by the researcher. Secondary data was collected by someone else and is reused.
Unpredictable differences that scatter results both above and below the true value, such as small timing slips.
A consistent fault that pushes results in one direction, such as a clock that runs fast.
draft.remember: Data is described by its form and its source. Random error scatters results, systematic error shifts them one way.

a.q: Jo reads a government report of survey results she did not collect. What type of data is this?
a.why: Someone else collected the data, so it is secondary. Primary data is tempting, but it must be collected first-hand by the researcher.

b.q: A stopwatch in a sprint study is set to run 0.2 seconds fast. Every time is too long. What type of error is this?
b.why: Every result is pushed the same way, so it is systematic error. Random error would make times scatter both above and below the true value.
b.clue: Do the results all shift the same way?
